document.abstract: This document specifies the wrapping of a stereoscopic 3D video stream using separated MXF files, which can be OP-Atom or OP-1a. This document follows the common provisions defined in Part 1 of this multipart document and defines the Header Metadata structure, Descriptor, and the Essence Container structure for the separated stereoscopic wrapping.
